class BugReportWindow:
    """Bug report dialog and report writer."""

    WIN = "bug_report_win"
    HANDLERS = "bug_report_handlers"

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._attachments: List[Path] = []
        self._selected_modules: set[str] = set()

    # -- public ---------------------------------------------------------

    def show(self, crash: bool = False) -> None:
        """Open the window. ``crash=True`` pre-fills it for a crash report."""
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self.WIN):
            dpg.focus_item(self.WIN)
            return

        self._attachments = []
        self._selected_modules = set()
        s = _scale()
        w, h = s(640), s(720)
        vp_w, vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_client_width(), dpg.get_viewport_client_height()

        has_prev = bool(get_session_log(previous=True))

        with dpg.window(
            label="Bug report",
            tag=self.WIN,
            width=w,
            height=h,
            pos=[max(0, (vp_w - w) // 2), max(0, (vp_h - h) // 2)],
            on_close=self._close,
        ):
            dpg.add_text("Describe the problem (what you did, what happened):")
            dpg.add_input_text(
                tag="bug_report_desc",
                multiline=True,
                width=-1,
                height=s(150),
                default_value=(
                    "The application crashed.\n\n" if crash else ""
                ),
            )

            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_text("Type:")
                dpg.add_combo(
                    ["Bug", "Crash", "Suggestion"],
                    default_value="Crash" if crash else "Bug",
                    width=s(120),
                    tag="bug_report_type",
                )

            dpg.add_separator()
            dpg.add_checkbox(label="Attach log", tag="bug_report_attach_log", default_value=True)
            with dpg.group(horizontal=True, indent=s(20)):
                dpg.add_radio_button(
                    ["Current session", "Previous session"],
                    horizontal=True,
                    tag="bug_report_log_which",
                    default_value="Previous session" if (crash and has_prev) else "Current session",
                )

            dpg.add_separator()
            dpg.add_text("Related modules (optional):")
            dpg.add_input_text(
                hint="Search modules...",
                width=-1,
                callback=lambda s_, a, u: dpg.set_value("bug_report_filter", a),
            )
            with dpg.child_window(height=s(130), border=True):
                with dpg.filter_set(tag="bug_report_filter"):
                    for name in self._available_module_names():
                        dpg.add_checkbox(
                            label=name,
                            filter_key=name,
                            callback=self._on_module_toggle,
                            user_data=name,
                        )

            dpg.add_separator()
            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_text("Attachments (images, text files...):")
                dpg.add_button(label="Browse...", callback=self._on_browse)
                dpg.add_button(label="Paste (Ctrl+V)", callback=self._on_paste)
            with dpg.child_window(tag="bug_report_attach_list", height=s(90), border=True):
                pass
            self._refresh_attachments()

            dpg.add_separator()
            dpg.add_text("", tag="bug_report_status", wrap=w - s(30))
            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_button(label="Send report", tag="bug_report_submit", callback=self._on_submit)
                dpg.add_button(label="Cancel", callback=self._close)

        with dpg.handler_registry(tag=self.HANDLERS):
            dpg.add_key_press_handler(dpg.mvKey_V, callback=self._on_key_v)

    # -- helpers --------------------------------------------------------

    @staticmethod
    def _available_module_names() -> List[str]:
        try:
            from core.module_registry import get_available_modules

            return sorted(get_available_modules().keys())
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Bug report: cannot list modules: {e}")
            return []

    @staticmethod
    def _ctrl_down() -> bool:
        for attr in ("mvKey_ModCtrl", "mvKey_Control", "mvKey_LControl", "mvKey_RControl"):
            key = getattr(dpg, attr, None)
            if key is not None and dpg.is_key_down(key):
                return True
        return False

    def _status(self, msg: str, color=(200, 200, 200)) -> None:
        if dpg.does_item_exist("bug_report_status"):
            dpg.set_value("bug_report_status", msg)
            dpg.configure_item("bug_report_status", color=color)

    def _close(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        for tag in (self.WIN, self.HANDLERS):
            if dpg.does_item_exist(tag):
                dpg.delete_item(tag)

    def _on_module_toggle(self, sender, app_data, user_data) -> None:
        (self._selected_modules.add if app_data else self._selected_modules.discard)(user_data)

    # -- attachments ----------------------------------------------------

    def _add_attachments(self, paths: List[Path]) -> None:
        for p in paths:
            if p not in self._attachments:
                self._attachments.append(p)
        self._refresh_attachments()

    def _refresh_attachments(self) -> None:
        if not dpg.does_item_exist("bug_report_attach_list"):
            return
        dpg.delete_item("bug_report_attach_list", children_only=True)
        if not self._attachments:
            dpg.add_text("No attachment", parent="bug_report_attach_list", color=(140, 140, 140))
        for p in self._attachments:
            with dpg.group(horizontal=True, parent="bug_report_attach_list"):
                dpg.add_button(label="X", callback=self._on_remove, user_data=p)
                dpg.add_text(p.name)

    def _on_remove(self, sender, app_data, user_data) -> None:
        if user_data in self._attachments:
            self._attachments.remove(user_data)
        self._refresh_attachments()

    def _on_browse(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        from core.file_explorer import file_explorer

        def _picked(path: str, ext: str = "") -> None:
            if path:
                self._add_attachments([Path(path)])

        file_explorer.select_file(callback=_picked)

    def _on_paste(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        files = _grab_clipboard()
        if files:
            self._add_attachments(files)
            self._status(f"{len(files)} item(s) pasted from clipboard.")
        else:
            self._status("No image or file found in the clipboard.", (230, 180, 80))

    def _on_key_v(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        if not dpg.does_item_exist(self.WIN) or not self._ctrl_down():
            return
        if dpg.is_item_focused(self.WIN) or dpg.is_item_hovered(self.WIN):
            files = _grab_clipboard()  # text clipboard -> empty -> ignored
            if files:
                self._add_attachments(files)
                self._status(f"{len(files)} item(s) pasted from clipboard.")

    # -- submit ---------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_submit(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        desc = dpg.get_value("bug_report_desc").strip()
        if not desc:
            self._status("Please describe the problem first.", (230, 120, 120))
            return
        try:
            folder = self._write_report(desc)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Failed to write bug report: {e}")
            self._status(f"Failed to save report: {e}", (230, 120, 120))
            return
        logger.info(f"Bug report saved: {folder}")
        self._close()
        self._show_done(folder)

    def _write_report(self, desc: str) -> Path:
        from core.app_state import app_state
        from core.module_registry import MODULES_REGISTRY

        now = datetime.datetime.now()
        folder = REPORTS_DIR / f"{now:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}"
        n = 1
        while folder.exists():
            n += 1
            folder = REPORTS_DIR / f"{now:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}_{n}"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)

        (folder / "description.txt").write_text(desc, encoding="utf-8")

        log_file: Optional[str] = None
        log_session = None
        if dpg.get_value("bug_report_attach_log"):
            previous = dpg.get_value("bug_report_log_which") == "Previous session"
            lines = get_session_log(previous=previous)
            if lines:
                (folder / "session.log").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
                log_file = "session.log"
                log_session = {"which": "previous" if previous else "current", "started": _session_date(lines)}
            else:
                logger.warning("Bug report: no session log found to attach")

        attached: List[str] = []
        if self._attachments:
            att_dir = folder / "attachments"
            att_dir.mkdir()
            for src in self._attachments:
                try:
                    dst = att_dir / src.name
                    i = 1
                    while dst.exists():
                        i += 1
                        dst = att_dir / f"{src.stem}_{i}{src.suffix}"
                    shutil.copy2(src, dst)
                    attached.append(dst.name)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Could not attach {src}: {e}")

        info: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "created": now.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "type": dpg.get_value("bug_report_type"),
            "description_file": "description.txt",
            "log_file": log_file,
            "log_session": log_session,
            "selected_modules": sorted(self._selected_modules),
            "active_modules": sorted(str(k) for k in MODULES_REGISTRY.keys()),
            "attachments": attached,
            "user": getattr(app_state, "username", None),
            "mode": getattr(app_state, "mode", None),
            "system": {
                "platform": platform.platform(),
                "python": sys.version.split()[0],
                "dearpygui": getattr(dpg, "get_dearpygui_version", lambda: "?")(),
            },
        }
        (folder / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        return folder

    def _show_done(self, folder: Path) -> None:
        tag = "bug_report_done"
        if dpg.does_item_exist(tag):
            dpg.delete_item(tag)
        s = _scale()
        vp_w, vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_client_width(), dpg.get_viewport_client_height()
        with dpg.window(
            label="Report saved", tag=tag, modal=True, width=s(460), height=s(150),
            pos=[max(0, (vp_w - s(460)) // 2), max(0, (vp_h - s(150)) // 2)],
        ):
            dpg.add_text("Thank you! Your report was saved in:")
            dpg.add_text(str(folder), wrap=s(430), color=(150, 200, 255))
            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_button(label="Open folder", callback=lambda *a: os.startfile(folder))
                dpg.add_button(label="Close", callback=lambda *a: dpg.delete_item(tag))

def show(self, crash: bool = False) -> None:

        self._refresh_attachments()

        dpg.add_separator()

        with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
            dpg.add_button(label="Send report", tag="bug_report_submit", callback=self._on_submit)
            dpg.add_button(label="Cancel", callback=self._close)

    with dpg.handler_registry(tag=self.HANDLERS):
        dpg.add_key_press_handler(dpg.mvKey_V, callback=self._on_key_v)

def show_crash_popup(pump_frames: bool = False) -> None:
    """
    Modal popup informing that the previous session ended abnormally.

    Same boot contract as ``login_dialog``: with ``pump_frames=True`` it blocks
    and pumps DPG frames until the user answers (call it at startup, before
    the main loop).
    """
    tag = "bug_report_crash_popup"
    if dpg.does_item_exist(tag):
        dpg.delete_item(tag)
    try:
        from config.display_scaling import display_scaling

        display_scaling.adapt_to_display()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(f"crash popup: display_scaling failed: {exc}")

    s = _scale()
    w = s(480)
    vp_w, vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_width(), dpg.get_viewport_height()
    open_report = [False]

    def _finish(*_: Any) -> None:
        if dpg.get_value("bug_report_crash_dontask"):
            from core.config_manager import config

            config.setdefault("General", {})["check_crash_on_boot"] = False
            config.save()
        if dpg.does_item_exist(tag):
            dpg.delete_item(tag)

    def _report(*_: Any) -> None:
        open_report[0] = True
        _finish()
        if not pump_frames:
            bug_report_window.show(crash=True)

    with dpg.window(
        label="Something went wrong",
        tag=tag,
        modal=True,
        no_close=True,
        autosize=True,
        pos=[max(0, (vp_w - w) // 2), max(0, (vp_h - s(190)) // 2)],
    ):
        dpg.add_text(
            "The application did not close properly last time (crash or forced exit).\n"
            "Would you like to report it? The log of the previous session can be attached.",
            wrap=w,
        )
        dpg.add_spacer(height=s(6))
        dpg.add_checkbox(label="Don't check for crashes at startup", tag="bug_report_crash_dontask")
        dpg.add_spacer(height=s(6))
        with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
            dpg.add_button(label="Report crash", callback=_report)
            dpg.add_button(label="Ignore", callback=_finish)

    if pump_frames:
        while dpg.is_dearpygui_running() and dpg.does_item_exist(tag):
            dpg.render_dearpygui_frame()
            try:
                vp_w, vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_client_width(), dpg.get_viewport_client_height()
                ww, wh = dpg.get_item_rect_size(tag)
                if ww > 0 and wh > 0:
                    dpg.set_item_pos(tag, [max(0, (vp_w - ww) // 2), max(0, (vp_h - wh) // 2)])
            except Exception:
                pass
        for _ in range(2):
            if dpg.is_dearpygui_running():
                dpg.render_dearpygui_frame()
        if open_report[0]:
            bug_report_window.show(crash=True)

class StartupDialog:
    """
    Startup Loader Dialog component class.

    Presents a centered modal dialog at boot allowing the user to select
    and load an Automation Script or a Pipeline.
    """

    MODE_SCRIPT = "Automation Script"
    MODE_PIPELINE = "Pipeline"

    def __init__(self, main_win: MainWin) -> None:
        self.main_win: MainWin = main_win
        self.winID: str = "startup_dialog_win"
        self._radio_tag: str = "startup_dialog_radio"
        self._listbox_tag: str = "startup_dialog_listbox"
        self._error_text_tag: str = "startup_dialog_error_text"

        self.selected_file: Optional[Path] = None
        self.file_maps: Dict[str, Dict[str, Path]] = {
            self.MODE_SCRIPT: {},
            self.MODE_PIPELINE: {},
        }
        self.confirmed_action: Optional[Tuple[str, Path]] = None
        self._pump_frames_active: bool = False

    def show(self, pump_frames: bool = False) -> None:
        """
        Display the startup dialog centered on screen.

        Args:
            pump_frames: If True, blocks and manually pumps DPG frames until
                         the window is closed (used before main loop starts).
        """
        try:
            from config.display_scaling import display_scaling

            display_scaling.adapt_to_display()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(f"StartupDialog: display_scaling failed: {exc}")

        self._pump_frames_active = pump_frames
        self.confirmed_action = None
        self._build_dialog()

        if pump_frames:
            while dpg.is_dearpygui_running() and dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
                from core.automation_manager import automation_manager

                automation_manager.process_pending_steps()
                dpg.render_dearpygui_frame()

                if not dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
                    break

                try:
                    vp_w = dpg.get_viewport_client_width()
                    vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_client_height()
                    win_size = dpg.get_item_rect_size(self.winID)
                    if win_size[0] > 0 and win_size[1] > 0:
                        pos_x = max(0, (vp_w - win_size[0]) // 2)
                        pos_y = max(0, (vp_h - win_size[1]) // 2)
                        dpg.set_item_pos(self.winID, [pos_x, pos_y])
                except Exception:
                    pass

            for _ in range(2):
                if dpg.is_dearpygui_running():
                    dpg.render_dearpygui_frame()

            self._pump_frames_active = False
            self._execute_confirmed_action()

    def _resolve_folder_path(self, folder_key: str, default_name: str) -> Path:
        """Resolve configured folder path relative to PROJECT_ROOT if needed."""
        paths_cfg = config.get("Paths", {})
        raw_folder = paths_cfg.get(folder_key, default_name) or default_name
        folder_path = Path(raw_folder.lstrip("/\\"))
        if not folder_path.is_absolute():
            folder_path = PROJECT_ROOT / folder_path
        return folder_path

    def _scan_folder_json_files(self, folder_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Path]:
        """Scan folder for .json files and return mapping of display labels to file paths."""
        files_map: Dict[str, Path] = {}
        if not folder_path.exists() or not folder_path.is_dir():
            logger.warning(f"Startup loader directory does not exist: {folder_path}")
            return files_map

        for file_path in sorted(folder_path.glob("*.json"), key=lambda p: p.name.lower()):
            files_map[file_path.name] = file_path

        return files_map

    def _refresh_file_list(self) -> None:
        selected_mode = dpg.get_value(self._radio_tag)
        folder_key = "default_pipeline_folder" if selected_mode == self.MODE_PIPELINE else "default_scripts_folder"
        default_folder_name = "pipelines" if selected_mode == self.MODE_PIPELINE else "scripts"
        folder_path = self._resolve_folder_path(folder_key, default_folder_name)

        file_map = self._scan_folder_json_files(folder_path)
        self.file_maps[selected_mode] = file_map

        items = list(file_map.keys())
        if items:
            dpg.configure_item(self._listbox_tag, items=items, num_items=min(8, max(4, len(items))))
            dpg.set_value(self._listbox_tag, items[0])
            self._on_file_selected(None, items[0], None)
        else:
            dpg.configure_item(self._listbox_tag, items=["(No files found)"], num_items=4)
            dpg.set_value(self._listbox_tag, "(No files found)")
            self.selected_file = None

    def _on_mode_change(
        self,
        sender: Any = None,
        app_data: Any = None,
        user_data: Any = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self._error_text_tag):
            dpg.configure_item(self._error_text_tag, show=False)
        self._refresh_file_list()

    def _on_file_selected(
        self,
        sender: Any = None,
        app_data: Any = None,
        user_data: Any = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self._error_text_tag):
            dpg.configure_item(self._error_text_tag, show=False)
        selected_mode = dpg.get_value(self._radio_tag)
        file_map = self.file_maps.get(selected_mode, {})
        file_name = dpg.get_value(self._listbox_tag)

        if file_name in file_map:
            file_path = file_map[file_name]
            self.selected_file = file_path
        else:
            self.selected_file = None

    def _on_browse(
        self,
        sender: Any = None,
        app_data: Any = None,
        user_data: Any = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        selected_mode = dpg.get_value(self._radio_tag)
        folder_key = "default_pipeline_folder" if selected_mode == self.MODE_PIPELINE else "default_scripts_folder"
        default_folder_name = "pipelines" if selected_mode == self.MODE_PIPELINE else "scripts"
        folder_path = self._resolve_folder_path(folder_key, default_folder_name)

        path_str = file_explorer.select_file(
            default_path=str(folder_path), extensions=[("JSON files", "*.json")]
        )
        if path_str:
            custom_path = Path(path_str)
            self.selected_file = custom_path

    def _execute_confirmed_action(self) -> None:
        """Execute confirmed pipeline or automation script load outside of modal frame loop."""
        if not self.confirmed_action:
            return
        selected_mode, selected_path = self.confirmed_action
        self.confirmed_action = None

        if selected_mode == self.MODE_PIPELINE:
            logger.info(f"Startup loader: loading pipeline '{selected_path}'")
            self.main_win.load_workspace_from_path(str(selected_path))
        else:
            logger.info(f"Startup loader: running automation script '{selected_path}'")
            from core.automation_manager import automation_manager

            automation_manager.set_script_path(str(selected_path))
            automation_manager.run()

    def _on_confirm(
        self,
        sender: Any = None,
        app_data: Any = None,
        user_data: Any = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        selected_path = self.selected_file
        if not selected_path or not selected_path.exists():
            if dpg.does_item_exist(self._error_text_tag):
                dpg.configure_item(self._error_text_tag, show=True)
            return

        selected_mode = dpg.get_value(self._radio_tag)
        self.confirmed_action = (selected_mode, selected_path)
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
            dpg.delete_item(self.winID)

        # If we are not running a blocking frame pump loop, execute action now
        if not self._pump_frames_active:
            self._execute_confirmed_action()

    def _on_skip(
        self,
        sender: Any = None,
        app_data: Any = None,
        user_data: Any = None,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
            dpg.delete_item(self.winID)
        logger.info("Startup loader: skipped, continuing with blank workspace")

    def _build_dialog(self) -> None:
        """Create the DPG startup loader window."""
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
            dpg.delete_item(self.winID)

        from config.display_scaling import display_scaling

        s = display_scaling.scale

        vp_w = dpg.get_viewport_width()
        vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_height()
        win_w = s(520)
        win_h = s(420)
        pos_x = max(0, (vp_w - win_w) // 2)
        pos_y = max(0, (vp_h - win_h) // 2)

        with dpg.window(
            label="Startup - Load Pipeline / Script",
            tag=self.winID,
            modal=True,
            no_close=True,
            no_resize=False,
            no_move=False,
            autosize=True,
            pos=[pos_x, pos_y],
        ):
            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(6))
            dpg.add_text("Choose a Script or Pipeline to load on startup:", color=(180, 180, 200, 255))
            dpg.add_separator()
            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(8))

            dpg.add_text("Configuration Type:")
            dpg.add_radio_button(
                tag=self._radio_tag,
                items=[self.MODE_SCRIPT, self.MODE_PIPELINE],
                default_value=self.MODE_SCRIPT,
                horizontal=True,
                callback=self._on_mode_change,
            )

            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(8))

            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_text("Available Files:")
                dpg.add_spacer(width=s(180))
                dpg.add_button(label="Browse...", callback=self._on_browse)

            dpg.add_listbox(
                tag=self._listbox_tag,
                items=[],
                width=win_w - s(30),
                num_items=6,
                callback=self._on_file_selected,
            )

            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(4))

            dpg.add_text(
                "Please select a valid .json file to load.",
                tag=self._error_text_tag,
                color=(255, 100, 100, 255),
                show=False,
            )

            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(12))
            dpg.add_separator()
            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(8))

            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_button(
                    label="Load Selected",
                    callback=self._on_confirm,
                    width=s(230),
                )
                dpg.add_button(
                    label="Start Empty Workspace",
                    callback=self._on_skip,
                    width=s(250),
                )

        self._refresh_file_list()

    """
    try:
        from config.display_scaling import display_scaling

        display_scaling.adapt_to_display()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(f"StartupDialog: display_scaling failed: {exc}")

    self._pump_frames_active = pump_frames
    self.confirmed_action = None
    self._build_dialog()

    if pump_frames:
        while dpg.is_dearpygui_running() and dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
            from core.automation_manager import automation_manager

            automation_manager.process_pending_steps()
            dpg.render_dearpygui_frame()

            if not dpg.does_item_exist(self.winID):
                break

            try:
                vp_w = dpg.get_viewport_client_width()
                vp_h = dpg.get_viewport_client_height()
                win_size = dpg.get_item_rect_size(self.winID)
                if win_size[0] > 0 and win_size[1] > 0:
                    pos_x = max(0, (vp_w - win_size[0]) // 2)
                    pos_y = max(0, (vp_h - win_size[1]) // 2)
                    dpg.set_item_pos(self.winID, [pos_x, pos_y])
            except Exception:
                pass

        for _ in range(2):
            if dpg.is_dearpygui_running():
                dpg.render_dearpygui_frame()

        self._pump_frames_active = False
        self._execute_confirmed_action()

class FlowMetricsViewer:
    """
    Real-Time Flow, Concurrency & Backpressure Diagnostics Window (Core Tool).

    Inspects active modules in MODULES_REGISTRY:
      - Normalized CPU % (0-100% across all cores) and Host CPU %,
      - Actual bounded queue capacities (buffer_size / _maxsize / max_queue_size),
      - Downstream backpressure holds via `is_outputs_ready()`,
      - Module self-readiness via `is_ready()`,
      - In-place colored status rows showing real-time flowing / waiting / saturated states.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.window_tag = "core_flow_metrics_viewer_win"
        self.table_tag = "core_flow_metrics_table"

        self._stop_event = threading.Event()
        self._thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self._refresh_interval_s: float = 0.5
        self._probe_enabled: bool = True

        self._probes: Dict[str, _ModuleProbe] = {}
        self._row_UUIDs: List[str] = []
        self._cell_tags: Dict[Tuple[str, str], int | str] = {}

        self._main_proc: Any = None
        self._child_procs: Dict[int, Any] = {}
        if _PSUTIL is not None:
            try:
                self._main_proc = _PSUTIL.Process(os.getpid())
                self._main_proc.cpu_percent(interval=None)
            except Exception:
                self._main_proc = None

    def show(self) -> None:
        """Creates or focuses the Flow Metrics Viewer window."""
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self.window_tag):
            dpg.show_item(self.window_tag)
            dpg.focus_item(self.window_tag)
            self._start_monitor()
            return

        with dpg.window(
            label="Flow & Concurrency Metrics (Real-Time Diagnostics)",
            tag=self.window_tag,
            width=1080,
            height=600,
            pos=[90, 80],
            on_close=self._on_close,
        ):
            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_text("UI FPS: --", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_fps")
                dpg.add_spacer(width=12)
                dpg.add_text("CPU: --%", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_cpu")
                dpg.add_spacer(width=12)
                dpg.add_text("RAM: -- MB", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_ram")
                dpg.add_spacer(width=12)
                dpg.add_text("Modules: 0", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_mod_count")
                dpg.add_spacer(width=12)
                dpg.add_text("Active Links: 0", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_link_count")
                dpg.add_spacer(width=12)
                dpg.add_text("Worker Processes: 0", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_worker_count")

            dpg.add_separator()

            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_slider_float(
                    label="Refresh (s)",
                    default_value=self._refresh_interval_s,
                    min_value=0.1,
                    max_value=2.0,
                    width=130,
                    callback=self._on_interval_change,
                )
                dpg.add_checkbox(
                    label="Instrument input_cb (Hz & exec ms)",
                    default_value=self._probe_enabled,
                    callback=self._on_toggle_probe,
                )
                dpg.add_button(
                    label="Export Snapshot (JSON)",
                    callback=self._on_export_snapshot,
                )
                dpg.add_text("", tag=f"{self.window_tag}_export_status", color=COLOR_OK)

            with dpg.group(horizontal=True):
                dpg.add_text("Visual Legend:", color=COLOR_MUTED)
                dpg.add_text("READY / FLOWING", color=COLOR_OK)
                dpg.add_text("|", color=COLOR_MUTED)
                dpg.add_text("BUSY / QUEUE FILL", color=COLOR_BUSY)
                dpg.add_text("|", color=COLOR_MUTED)
                dpg.add_text("WAITING (DOWNSTREAM BLOCKED) / SATURATED", color=COLOR_WAITING)

            dpg.add_separator()

            with dpg.table(
                tag=self.table_tag,
                header_row=True,
                resizable=True,
                policy=dpg.mvTable_SizingStretchProp,
                borders_outerH=True,
                borders_innerV=True,
                borders_innerH=True,
                borders_outerV=True,
                row_background=True,
                scrollY=True,
                height=-1,
            ):
                dpg.add_table_column(label="UUID", init_width_or_weight=0.6)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="Module Label (Class)", init_width_or_weight=1.5)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="Flow State (Ready / Waiting)", init_width_or_weight=1.3)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="Links Out", init_width_or_weight=0.5)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="In Rate (Hz)", init_width_or_weight=0.7)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="input_cb (ms)", init_width_or_weight=0.9)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="Worker Status", init_width_or_weight=0.9)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="In Queue", init_width_or_weight=0.7)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="Drop Policy", init_width_or_weight=0.7)
                dpg.add_table_column(label="Telemetry / Drops", init_width_or_weight=1.3)

        self._start_monitor()

    def _on_interval_change(self, sender: Any = None, app_data: Any = None, user_data: Any = None, *args: Any) -> None:
        try:
            self._refresh_interval_s = max(0.1, float(app_data))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _on_toggle_probe(self, sender: Any = None, app_data: Any = None, user_data: Any = None, *args: Any) -> None:
        self._probe_enabled = bool(app_data)
        if not self._probe_enabled:
            self._detach_all_probes()

    def _on_close(self, sender: Any = None, app_data: Any = None, user_data: Any = None, *args: Any) -> None:
        self._stop_event.set()
        self._detach_all_probes()

    def _detach_all_probes(self) -> None:
        registry_snapshot = dict(MODULES_REGISTRY)
        for uid, probe in list(self._probes.items()):
            mod = registry_snapshot.get(uid)
            if mod is not None:
                probe.detach(mod)
        self._probes.clear()

    def _start_monitor(self) -> None:
        if self._thread is not None and self._thread.is_alive():
            return
        self._stop_event.clear()
        self._thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._monitor_loop,
            daemon=True,
            name="FlowMetricsMonitor",
        )
        self._thread.start()

    def _discover_processor(self, mod: Any) -> Optional[Any]:
        """Finds any ProcessingBase or ViewportProcessBase attached to a module."""
        if hasattr(mod, "_in_queue") and hasattr(mod, "_process"):
            return mod
        for attr in ("proc", "processor", "_proc", "_processor", "worker"):
            cand = getattr(mod, attr, None)
            if cand is not None and (hasattr(cand, "_in_queue") or hasattr(cand, "_process")):
                return cand
        try:
            for val in vars(mod).values():
                if val is not None and hasattr(val, "_in_queue") and hasattr(val, "_process"):
                    return val
        except Exception:
            pass
        return None

    def _collect_process_usage(self) -> Tuple[float, float, float, int]:
        """
        Returns (proc_cpu_norm_pct, sys_cpu_pct, total_rss_mb, worker_proc_count).
        All CPU values are normalized to 0-100% across all cores.
        """
        if self._main_proc is None or _PSUTIL is None:
            return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0
        try:
            cores = os.cpu_count() or 1
            cpu_raw_total = float(self._main_proc.cpu_percent(interval=None))
            rss_total = float(self._main_proc.memory_info().rss)
            children = self._main_proc.children(recursive=True)
            active_pids = set()
            for ch in children:
                active_pids.add(ch.pid)
                if ch.pid not in self._child_procs:
                    self._child_procs[ch.pid] = ch
                    try:
                        ch.cpu_percent(interval=None)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                else:
                    cached = self._child_procs[ch.pid]
                    try:
                        cpu_raw_total += float(cached.cpu_percent(interval=None))
                        rss_total += float(cached.memory_info().rss)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            for stale_pid in list(self._child_procs.keys()):
                if stale_pid not in active_pids:
                    self._child_procs.pop(stale_pid, None)

            # Normalize process tree CPU across all logical cores so it never exceeds 100%
            proc_cpu_norm = max(0.0, min(100.0, cpu_raw_total / cores))

            # System-wide overall CPU (0-100%)
            sys_cpu = 0.0
            try:
                sys_cpu = float(_PSUTIL.cpu_percent(interval=None))
            except Exception:
                sys_cpu = proc_cpu_norm

            return proc_cpu_norm, sys_cpu, rss_total / (1024.0 * 1024.0), len(active_pids)
        except Exception:
            return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0

    def _extract_queue_details(self, mod: Any, proc: Optional[Any]) -> Tuple[str, str, float, int, int]:
        """
        Extracts actual queue fill string, drop policy, fill ratio, qsize, and maxsize.
        Checks buffer_size, _maxsize, and max_queue_size across proc and mod.
        """
        target = proc if proc is not None else mod
        in_q = getattr(target, "_in_queue", None)
        if in_q is None:
            return "N/A", "N/A", 0.0, 0, 0

        # Resolve real maximum queue capacity
        max_q: Optional[int] = None
        # 1. mp.Queue internal _maxsize attribute
        if hasattr(in_q, "_maxsize") and isinstance(in_q._maxsize, int) and in_q._maxsize > 0:
            max_q = in_q._maxsize
        # 2. buffer_size on proc or mod (ProcessingBase convention)
        if max_q is None and hasattr(target, "buffer_size") and isinstance(target.buffer_size, int) and target.buffer_size > 0:
            max_q = target.buffer_size
        if max_q is None and hasattr(mod, "buffer_size") and isinstance(mod.buffer_size, int) and mod.buffer_size > 0:
            max_q = mod.buffer_size
        # 3. max_queue_size attribute
        if max_q is None and hasattr(mod, "max_queue_size") and isinstance(mod.max_queue_size, int) and mod.max_queue_size > 0:
            max_q = mod.max_queue_size
        if max_q is None and hasattr(target, "max_queue_size") and isinstance(target.max_queue_size, int) and target.max_queue_size > 0:
            max_q = target.max_queue_size
        if max_q is None or max_q <= 0:
            max_q = 1

        # Resolve current queue size (prefer target.queue_size() so worker-side drop_oldest buffers are included)
        q_size = 0
        q_size_str = "0"
        q_fn = getattr(target, "queue_size", None)
        try:
            q_val = int(q_fn()) if callable(q_fn) else -1
            if q_val >= 0:
                q_size = q_val
            else:
                q_size = in_q.qsize()
            q_size_str = str(q_size)
        except (NotImplementedError, AttributeError, Exception):
            try:
                q_size = 1 if not in_q.empty() else 0
                q_size_str = f"~{q_size}"
            except Exception:
                q_size = 0
                q_size_str = "?"

        fill_ratio = (q_size / max_q) if max_q > 0 else 0.0
        q_fill_str = f"{q_size_str} / {max_q}"

        raw_policy = getattr(
            target,
            "_drop_policy",
            getattr(target, "drop_policy", getattr(mod, "drop_policy", "drop_new")),
        )
        if isinstance(raw_policy, bool):
            policy_str = "drop_oldest" if raw_policy else "drop_new"
        else:
            policy_str = str(raw_policy or "drop_new")

        return q_fill_str, policy_str, fill_ratio, q_size, max_q

    def _collect_snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Gathers a point-in-time snapshot of all registered modules and system state."""
        now = time.perf_counter()
        fps = float(dpg.get_frame_rate()) if dpg.is_dearpygui_running() else 0.0
        registry_snapshot = dict(MODULES_REGISTRY)

        # Clean up probes for removed modules
        for uid in list(self._probes.keys()):
            if uid not in registry_snapshot:
                self._probes.pop(uid, None)

        total_links = 0
        worker_count = 0
        modules_info: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        for uuid_key, mod in registry_snapshot.items():
            uid_str = str(uuid_key)
            cls_name = type(mod).__name__
            label = getattr(mod, "label", cls_name)

            if self._probe_enabled:
                probe = self._probes.get(uid_str)
                if probe is None:
                    probe = _ModuleProbe(uid_str)
                    self._probes[uid_str] = probe
                probe.attach(mod)
                in_rate_hz, mean_exec_ms, p95_exec_ms, total_calls, mean_render_ms = probe.stats(now)
            else:
                in_rate_ms_Attr = getattr(mod, "last_exec_ms", 0.0)
                in_rate_hz, mean_exec_ms, p95_exec_ms, total_calls, mean_render_ms = (
                    0.0,
                    float(in_rate_ms_Attr),
                    0.0,
                    0,
                    0.0,
                )

            # Fallback if module tracks its own rate (e.g. source generators or threaded viewers)
            mod_rate = getattr(mod, "measured_rate_hz", None)
            if in_rate_hz == 0.0 and mod_rate is not None:
                try:
                    in_rate_hz = float(mod_rate)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if in_rate_hz == 0.0:
                read_last_t = getattr(mod, "_read_last_time", None)
                if isinstance(read_last_t, (int, float)) and (time.time() - float(read_last_t)) <= 2.0:
                    in_rate_hz = float(
                        getattr(mod, "_read_smoothed_fps", 0.0)
                        or getattr(mod, "_read_raw_fps", 0.0)
                    )

            # Count active outgoing links
            mod_links = 0
            connections = getattr(mod, "connections", None)
            if isinstance(connections, dict):
                for targets in connections.values():
                    if isinstance(targets, (list, dict)):
                        mod_links += len(targets)
            total_links += mod_links

            # Downstream backpressure check via WindowBase.is_outputs_ready()
            outputs_ready = True
            if hasattr(mod, "is_outputs_ready") and callable(mod.is_outputs_ready):
                try:
                    outputs_ready = bool(mod.is_outputs_ready())
                except Exception:
                    outputs_ready = True

            # Inspect attached worker process if any
            proc = self._discover_processor(mod)
            worker_status = "UI-Thread"
            worker_color = COLOR_STANDBY
            self_ready = True

            if proc is not None and hasattr(proc, "is_ready") and callable(proc.is_ready):
                try:
                    self_ready = bool(proc.is_ready())
                except Exception:
                    self_ready = True
            elif hasattr(mod, "is_ready") and callable(mod.is_ready):
                try:
                    self_ready = bool(mod.is_ready())
                except Exception:
                    self_ready = True

            q_fill_str, drop_policy, fill_ratio, q_size, max_q = self._extract_queue_details(mod, proc)

            if proc is not None:
                p_obj = getattr(proc, "_process", None)
                if p_obj is not None:
                    try:
                        if p_obj.is_alive():
                            worker_status = f"Alive (PID {p_obj.pid})"
                            worker_color = COLOR_OK
                            worker_count += 1
                        else:
                            worker_status = f"Stopped (exit={p_obj.exitcode})"
                            worker_color = COLOR_WAITING
                    except Exception:
                        worker_status = "Error"
                        worker_color = COLOR_WAITING
                else:
                    worker_status = "Idle"
                    worker_color = COLOR_MUTED

            # Determine Flow State and its visual alert color
            if mod_links > 0 and not outputs_ready:
                flow_state = "WAITING (Blocked Downstream)"
                flow_color = COLOR_WAITING
            elif not self_ready:
                flow_state = "SATURATED (Not Ready)"
                flow_color = COLOR_WAITING
            elif max_q > 0 and fill_ratio >= 1.0:
                flow_state = "QUEUE FULL"
                flow_color = COLOR_WAITING
            elif max_q > 0 and fill_ratio >= 0.5:
                flow_state = "BUSY (Queue Filling)"
                flow_color = COLOR_BUSY
            elif proc is not None:
                flow_state = "FLOWING (Worker)"
                flow_color = COLOR_OK
            elif in_rate_hz > 0:
                flow_state = "FLOWING (UI-Thread)"
                flow_color = COLOR_OK
            else:
                flow_state = "READY (Standby)"
                flow_color = COLOR_STANDBY

            # Color for queue column
            if q_fill_str == "N/A":
                q_color = COLOR_MUTED
            elif fill_ratio >= 1.0:
                q_color = COLOR_WAITING
            elif fill_ratio >= 0.5:
                q_color = COLOR_BUSY
            else:
                q_color = COLOR_OK

            # Inspect custom benchmark/telemetry attributes if exposed by module
            lat_ms = getattr(mod, "last_latency_ms", None)
            drops = getattr(mod, "dropped_count", None)
            custom_parts: List[str] = []
            if mean_render_ms > 0.0:
                disp_fps = float(
                    getattr(mod, "_display_smoothed_fps", 0.0)
                    or getattr(mod, "_display_raw_fps", 0.0)
                )
                custom_parts.append(f"tex={mean_render_ms:.2f}ms ({disp_fps:.0f}fps)")
            if lat_ms is not None:
                try:
                    custom_parts.append(f"lat={float(lat_ms):.2f}ms")
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if drops is not None:
                try:
                    custom_parts.append(f"drops={int(drops)}")
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if not custom_parts and total_calls > 0:
                custom_parts.append(f"calls={total_calls}")

            has_drops = bool(drops is not None and int(drops) > 0)
            telemetry_color = COLOR_WAITING if has_drops else COLOR_MUTED

            links_color = COLOR_WAITING if (mod_links > 0 and not outputs_ready) else COLOR_WHITE

            row_data = {
                "uuid": (uid_str, COLOR_MUTED),
                "label": (f"{label} ({cls_name})", COLOR_WHITE),
                "flow_state": (flow_state, flow_color),
                "links_out": (f"{mod_links} {'(HOLD)' if not outputs_ready and mod_links > 0 else ''}", links_color),
                "in_rate_hz": (f"{in_rate_hz:.1f} Hz", COLOR_WHITE),
                "exec_ms": (f"{mean_exec_ms:.2f} / {p95_exec_ms:.2f}", COLOR_WHITE),
                "worker_status": (worker_status, worker_color),
                "in_queue": (q_fill_str, q_color),
                "drop_policy": (drop_policy, COLOR_WHITE),
                "telemetry": (", ".join(custom_parts) if custom_parts else "-", telemetry_color),
            }

            modules_info.append(
                {
                    "uuid": uid_str,
                    "label": f"{label} ({cls_name})",
                    "flow_state": flow_state,
                    "links_out": mod_links,
                    "in_rate_hz": round(in_rate_hz, 2),
                    "exec_mean_ms": round(mean_exec_ms, 3),
                    "exec_p95_ms": round(p95_exec_ms, 3),
                    "worker_status": worker_status,
                    "in_queue": q_fill_str,
                    "drop_policy": drop_policy,
                    "telemetry": ", ".join(custom_parts) if custom_parts else "-",
                    "row_data": row_data,
                }
            )

        proc_cpu_norm, sys_cpu, mem_mb, child_count = self._collect_process_usage()

        return {
            "timestamp_epoch": time.time(),
            "ui_fps": round(fps, 1),
            "module_count": len(modules_info),
            "active_links": total_links,
            "worker_processes": max(worker_count, child_count),
            "proc_cpu_percent": round(proc_cpu_norm, 1),
            "sys_cpu_percent": round(sys_cpu, 1),
            "memory_rss_mb": round(mem_mb, 1),
            "modules": modules_info,
        }

    def _rebuild_table_rows(self, modules: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        if not dpg.does_item_exist(self.table_tag):
            return
        children = dpg.get_item_children(self.table_tag, 1)
        if children:
            for row_id in children:
                dpg.delete_item(row_id)

        self._cell_tags.clear()
        self._row_UUIDs = [m["uuid"] for m in modules]
        cols = (
            "uuid",
            "label",
            "flow_state",
            "links_out",
            "in_rate_hz",
            "exec_ms",
            "worker_status",
            "in_queue",
            "drop_policy",
            "telemetry",
        )
        for m in modules:
            uid = m["uuid"]
            with dpg.table_row(parent=self.table_tag):
                for col in cols:
                    txt_id = dpg.add_text("")
                    self._cell_tags[(uid, col)] = txt_id

    def _update_ui(self, snap: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if not dpg.does_item_exist(self.window_tag):
            return

        dpg.set_value(f"{self.window_tag}_fps", f"UI FPS: {snap['ui_fps']:.1f}")
        dpg.set_value(
            f"{self.window_tag}_cpu",
            f"CPU: {snap['proc_cpu_percent']:.1f}% (Host: {snap['sys_cpu_percent']:.1f}%)",
        )
        dpg.set_value(f"{self.window_tag}_ram", f"RAM: {snap['memory_rss_mb']:.1f} MB")
        dpg.set_value(f"{self.window_tag}_mod_count", f"Modules: {snap['module_count']}")
        dpg.set_value(f"{self.window_tag}_link_count", f"Active Links: {snap['active_links']}")
        dpg.set_value(f"{self.window_tag}_worker_count", f"Worker Processes: {snap['worker_processes']}")

        modules = snap["modules"]
        current_uuids = [m["uuid"] for m in modules]
        if current_uuids != self._row_UUIDs:
            self._rebuild_table_rows(modules)

        for m in modules:
            uid = m["uuid"]
            row_data = m["row_data"]
            for col, (text_val, color_val) in row_data.items():
                tag = self._cell_tags.get((uid, col))
                if tag is not None and dpg.does_item_exist(tag):
                    dpg.set_value(tag, text_val)
                    if color_val is not None:
                        dpg.configure_item(tag, color=color_val)

    def _monitor_loop(self) -> None:
        while not self._stop_event.is_set():
            if not dpg.is_dearpygui_running() or not dpg.does_item_exist(self.window_tag):
                break
            try:
                if dpg.is_item_shown(self.window_tag):
                    snap = self._collect_snapshot()
                    self._update_ui(snap)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.debug(f"FlowMetricsViewer update error: {exc}")

            self._stop_event.wait(self._refresh_interval_s)

    def _on_export_snapshot(self, sender: Any = None, app_data: Any = None, user_data: Any = None, *args: Any) -> None:
        try:
            snap = self._collect_snapshot()
            out_dir: Path = LOGS_DIR / "benchmarks"
            out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            filename = out_dir / f"flow_metrics_snapshot_{int(time.time())}.json"
            clean_snap = dict(snap)
            # Remove non-serializable UI tuples from export
            clean_modules = []
            for m in snap["modules"]:
                cm = dict(m)
                cm.pop("row_data", None)
                clean_modules.append(cm)
            clean_snap["modules"] = clean_modules

            with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(clean_snap, f, indent=2)
            if dpg.does_item_exist(f"{self.window_tag}_export_status"):
                dpg.set_value(f"{self.window_tag}_export_status", f"Saved: {filename.name}")
            logger.info(f"Exported flow metrics snapshot to {filename}")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error(f"Failed to export flow metrics snapshot: {exc}")

docs.title: Shared Memory Transport
docs.text: Transparent shared-memory transport for large numpy arrays crossing ProcessingBase queues.

docs.title: Why
docs.text: multiprocessing.Queue pickles every payload: a 640x480x3 frame is copied into a pickle buffer, pushed through an OS pipe in chunks (many GIL release/re-acquire cycles), read back and unpickled. At high frame rates this saturates the producer process (feeder threads + GIL contention) long before the worker does.

docs.title: How
docs.text:
Each direction (main -> worker, worker -> main) owns a small pool of reusable shared-memory slots.

producer: encode(obj)  -> every large C-compatible np.ndarray found in obj (also inside tuple / list /
                          dict, a few levels deep) is copied into a free slot and replaced by a tiny
                          ShmRef(slot, name, shape, dtype). Only this descriptor goes through the pipe.
consumer: decode(obj)  -> arrays are copied out of their slots into regular numpy arrays and the slots
                          are released immediately (the consumer owns ordinary arrays, exactly as with
                          pickle: user code may keep references safely).
dropped items          -> release_item(obj) frees their slots without reading them.

Everything is best-effort and transparent: small arrays, exotic dtypes, ndarray subclasses, other Python objects, an exhausted pool or a memory cap reached simply fall back to the regular pickle path.

Slots are allocated lazily by the producing process and re-created (bigger) when a larger array shows up. Slot ownership is tracked with a shared flag array: a slot is only reused once the consumer released it, so the producer never overwrites data that is still being read.

class ShmEnvelope:

    def __init__(self, payload: Any, slots: List[int]) -> None:

        self.slots = slots

    def __reduce__(self) -> Any:
        return (ShmEnvelope, (self.payload, self.slots))

class ShmPool:
    """
    Pool of shared-memory slots for ONE direction (one producer process, one consumer process).

    Picklable at process-spawn time (shared flag array + lock); per-process handles are rebuilt locally.
    """

    def __init__(self, n_slots: int, threshold_bytes: int, max_total_bytes: int) -> None:
        self.n_slots = max(1, int(n_slots))
        self.threshold_bytes = max(1, int(threshold_bytes))
        self.max_total_bytes = max(0, int(max_total_bytes))
        self._flags = mp.RawArray("b", self.n_slots)  # 0 = free, 1 = in flight
        self._lock = mp.Lock()
        self._init_local()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ pickling / per-process state
    def _init_local(self) -> None:
        self._local_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._owned: Dict[int, Tuple[shared_memory.SharedMemory, int]] = {}  # producer side
        self._owned_bytes = 0
        self._attached: Dict[int, shared_memory.SharedMemory] = {}  # consumer side
        self._hint = 0

    def __getstate__(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        state = self.__dict__.copy()
        for key in ("_local_lock", "_owned", "_owned_bytes", "_attached", "_hint"):
            state.pop(key, None)
        return state

    def __setstate__(self, state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.__dict__.update(state)
        self._init_local()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ slot bookkeeping
    def _acquire_slot(self) -> int:
        flags = self._flags
        n = self.n_slots
        with self._lock:
            start = self._hint
            for k in range(n):
                i = (start + k) % n
                if flags[i] == 0:
                    flags[i] = 1
                    self._hint = (i + 1) % n
                    return i
        return -1

    def release(self, slot: int) -> None:
        if 0 <= slot < self.n_slots:
            self._flags[slot] = 0

    def release_item(self, obj: Any) -> None:
        """Free the slots of an item that will never be decoded (dropped / cleared)."""
        if type(obj) is ShmEnvelope:
            for s in obj.slots:
                self.release(s)

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Mark every slot free (only when no item can be in flight anymore, e.g. worker stopped)."""
        with self._lock:
            for i in range(self.n_slots):
                self._flags[i] = 0

    def in_flight(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for i in range(self.n_slots) if self._flags[i])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ producer side
    def _owned_segment(self, slot: int, nbytes: int) -> Optional[shared_memory.SharedMemory]:
        with self._local_lock:
            entry = self._owned.get(slot)
            if entry is not None and entry[1] >= nbytes:
                return entry[0]
            need = _round_up(nbytes)
            cur = entry[1] if entry is not None else 0
            if self._owned_bytes - cur + need > self.max_total_bytes:
                return None
            # The slot is ours (flag set) and was released by the consumer: safe to replace it.
            if entry is not None:
                _close_quiet(entry[0], unlink=True)
                self._owned_bytes -= cur
                del self._owned[slot]
            shm = shared_memory.SharedMemory(create=True, size=need)
            self._owned[slot] = (shm, need)
            self._owned_bytes += need
            return shm

    def _put_array(self, arr: Any) -> Optional[ShmRef]:
        slot = self._acquire_slot()
        if slot < 0:
            return None
        try:
            shm = self._owned_segment(slot, arr.nbytes)
            if shm is None:
                self.release(slot)
                return None
            dst = np.ndarray(arr.shape, dtype=arr.dtype, buffer=shm.buf)
            np.copyto(dst, arr, casting="no")
            del dst  # drop the buffer export so the segment can be closed later
            return ShmRef(slot, shm.name, tuple(arr.shape), arr.dtype.str)
        except Exception:
            self.release(slot)
            return None

    def _enc(self, x: Any, slots: List[int], depth: int) -> Any:
        t = type(x)
        if t is np.ndarray:
            if x.nbytes >= self.threshold_bytes and x.dtype.kind in _ALLOWED_KINDS and not x.dtype.hasobject:
                ref = self._put_array(x)
                if ref is not None:
                    slots.append(ref.slot)
                    return ref
            return x
        if depth >= _MAX_DEPTH:
            return x
        if t is tuple or t is list:
            if len(x) > _MAX_CONTAINER_LEN:
                return x
            changed = False
            items = []
            for v in x:
                nv = self._enc(v, slots, depth + 1)
                changed = changed or (nv is not v)
                items.append(nv)
            if not changed:
                return x
            return tuple(items) if t is tuple else items
        if t is dict:
            if len(x) > _MAX_CONTAINER_LEN:
                return x
            changed = False
            out: Dict[Any, Any] = {}
            for k, v in x.items():
                nv = self._enc(v, slots, depth + 1)
                changed = changed or (nv is not v)
                out[k] = nv
            return out if changed else x
        return x

    def encode(self, obj: Any) -> Any:
        """Move large arrays of `obj` to shared memory. Returns `obj` unchanged if nothing was moved."""
        if np is None:
            return obj
        slots: List[int] = []
        try:
            payload = self._enc(obj, slots, 0)
        except Exception:
            for s in slots:
                self.release(s)
            return obj
        if not slots:
            return obj
        return ShmEnvelope(payload, slots)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ consumer side
    def _read(self, ref: ShmRef) -> Any:
        with self._local_lock:
            shm = self._attached.get(ref.slot)
            if shm is None or shm.name != ref.name:
                _close_quiet(shm)
                shm = _attach(ref.name)
                self._attached[ref.slot] = shm
        view = np.ndarray(ref.shape, dtype=np.dtype(ref.dtype), buffer=shm.buf)
        out = view.copy()
        del view
        return out

    def _dec(self, x: Any) -> Any:
        t = type(x)
        if t is ShmRef:
            return self._read(x)
        if t is tuple:
            return tuple(self._dec(v) for v in x)
        if t is list:
            return [self._dec(v) for v in x]
        if t is dict:
            return {k: self._dec(v) for k, v in x.items()}
        return x

    def decode(self, obj: Any) -> Any:
        """Rebuild the original payload (arrays copied out) and release its slots."""
        if type(obj) is not ShmEnvelope:
            return obj
        try:
            return self._dec(obj.payload)
        finally:
            for s in obj.slots:
                self.release(s)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ teardown
    def close(self) -> None:
        """Close this process' handles (and unlink owned segments on POSIX)."""
        lock = getattr(self, "_local_lock", None)
        if lock is None:
            return
        with lock:
            for shm, _cap in self._owned.values():
                _close_quiet(shm, unlink=True)
            self._owned.clear()
            self._owned_bytes = 0
            for shm in self._attached.values():
                _close_quiet(shm)
            self._attached.clear()

class DocumentationManager:
    """
    Manager for launching and managing the local MkDocs server.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.error_win_id: str = "doc_error_win"
        self.process: Optional[subprocess.Popen[str]] = None
        self.port: Optional[int] = None

    def find_free_port(self, start_port: int = 8000) -> int:
        """Find an available port starting from start_port."""
        for port in range(start_port, start_port + 50):
            with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
                try:
                    s.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
                    return port
                except OSError:
                    continue
        return start_port

    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        """Check if the mkdocs server process is running."""
        return self.process is not None and self.process.poll() is None

    def start_server(self) -> None:
        """Start the mkdocs local server and open the browser."""
        if self.is_running():
            return

        mkdocs_file = PROJECT_ROOT / "mkdocs.yml"
        if not mkdocs_file.exists():
            logger.error("mkdocs.yml not found in project root.")
            self._show_error_dialog(
                "Configuration Error",
                f"mkdocs.yml was not found in the project root:\n{PROJECT_ROOT}",
            )
            return

        # Dynamically re-index modules documentation before starting the server
        self._reindex_modules_docs()

        self.port = self.find_free_port(8000)
        try:
            startupinfo = None
            if sys.platform == "win32":
                startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
                startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
                startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0  # SW_HIDE

            # Run Python module mkdocs serve on the found local port
            cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "mkdocs", "serve", "-a", f"127.0.0.1:{self.port}"]
            logger.info(f"Starting mkdocs server on port {self.port}: {' '.join(cmd)}")

            self.process = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT),
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
            )

            # Wait briefly to see if it immediately fails/exits
            time.sleep(1.5)
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                _, stderr = self.process.communicate()
                logger.error(f"MkDocs failed to start: {stderr}")
                self.process = None
                self._show_error_dialog(
                    "MkDocs Launch Failed",
                    "Failed to start MkDocs. Please ensure 'mkdocs' and its extensions are installed:\n\n"
                    "pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mkdocstrings-python\n\n"
                    f"Details:\n{stderr}",
                )
                return

            log_mkdocs = config.get("Debug", {}).get("log_mkdocs", False)

            def consume_stream(stream: Any) -> None:
                try:
                    for line in stream:
                        cleaned = line.strip()
                        if not cleaned or not log_mkdocs:
                            continue
                        if "ERROR" in cleaned or "CRITICAL" in cleaned:
                            logger.bind(mkdocs=True).error(f"[MkDocs] {cleaned}")
                        elif "WARNING" in cleaned:
                            logger.bind(mkdocs=True).warning(f"[MkDocs] {cleaned}")
                        else:
                            logger.bind(mkdocs=True).info(f"[MkDocs] {cleaned}")
                except Exception:
                    pass

            if self.process.stdout:
                threading.Thread(target=consume_stream, args=(self.process.stdout,), daemon=True).start()
            if self.process.stderr:
                threading.Thread(target=consume_stream, args=(self.process.stderr,), daemon=True).start()

            logger.info(f"Opening browser at http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}")
            webbrowser.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}")
            self.update_menu_visibility()

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to spawn mkdocs subprocess: {e}")
            self.process = None
            self._show_error_dialog("Subprocess Error", f"Could not launch the MkDocs process:\n{e}")

    def stop_server(self) -> None:
        """Stop the mkdocs subprocess."""
        if self.process:
            logger.info("Stopping mkdocs server...")
            try:
                self.process.terminate()
                self.process.wait(timeout=2)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Error terminating mkdocs process gracefully: {e}")
                try:
                    self.process.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.process = None
        self.update_menu_visibility()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Stop method mapping for application cleanup on shutdown."""
        self.stop_server()

    def reopen_link(self) -> None:
        """Reopen the documentation website in the default browser."""
        if self.port:
            logger.info(f"Reopening browser at http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}")
            webbrowser.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}")

    def update_menu_visibility(self) -> None:
        """Update display status of Documentation menu items dynamically based on server status."""
        running = self.is_running()
        if dpg.does_item_exist("doc_open_item"):
            dpg.configure_item("doc_open_item", show=running)
        if dpg.does_item_exist("doc_start_item"):
            dpg.configure_item("doc_start_item", show=not running)
        if dpg.does_item_exist("doc_stop_item"):
            dpg.configure_item("doc_stop_item", show=running)

    def _show_error_dialog(self, title: str, message: str) -> None:
        """Helper to show a nice error/warning dialog."""
        s = display_scaling.scale
        if dpg.does_item_exist(self.error_win_id):
            dpg.delete_item(self.error_win_id)

        with dpg.window(
            label=title,
            tag=self.error_win_id,
            width=s(450),
            height=s(220),
            modal=True,
            pos=(s(300), s(200)),
        ):
            dpg.add_text("An error occurred:", color=(255, 100, 100))
            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(5))
            dpg.add_text(message, wrap=s(430))
            dpg.add_spacer(height=s(15))
            dpg.add_button(label="OK", callback=lambda: dpg.delete_item(self.error_win_id), width=s(80))

    def _reindex_modules_docs(self) -> None:
        """Dynamically scan the modules directory and update mkdocs.yml navigation."""
        modules_dir = PROJECT_ROOT / "modules"
        docs_modules_dir = PROJECT_ROOT / "docs" / "modules"
        mkdocs_yml_path = PROJECT_ROOT / "mkdocs.yml"

        logger.info("Scanning and indexing modules documentation...")
        try:
            # 1. Clean and recreate docs/modules directory
            if docs_modules_dir.exists():
                try:
                    shutil.rmtree(docs_modules_dir)
                except Exception:
                    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(docs_modules_dir, topdown=False):
                        for name in files:
                            filepath = Path(root) / name
                            try:
                                os.chmod(filepath, stat.S_IWRITE)
                                os.unlink(filepath)
                            except Exception:
                                pass
                        for name in dirs:
                            dirpath = Path(root) / name
                            try:
                                os.rmdir(dirpath)
                            except Exception:
                                pass
            docs_modules_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            if not modules_dir.exists():
                logger.warning(f"Modules directory {modules_dir} does not exist.")
                return

            # 2. Build hierarchical tree of directories containing .md files
            nav_tree: Dict[str, Any] = {"files": {}, "children": {}}

            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(modules_dir):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith("__") and d != "__pycache__"]

                md_files = [f for f in files if f.lower().endswith(".md")]
                if not md_files:
                    continue

                rel_dir = Path(root).relative_to(modules_dir)
                dst_dir = docs_modules_dir / rel_dir
                dst_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

                parts = rel_dir.parts
                current = nav_tree
                for part in parts:
                    current = current["children"].setdefault(part, {"files": {}, "children": {}})

                for f in md_files:
                    src_path = Path(root) / f
                    try:
                        if f.lower() == "readme.md":
                            shutil.copy2(src_path, dst_dir / "index.md")
                            title = rel_dir.name if rel_dir != Path(".") else "Modules Documentation"
                            if rel_dir == Path("."):
                                nav_tree["files"][title] = "modules/index.md"
                            else:
                                current["files"][title] = f"modules/{'/'.join(parts)}/index.md"
                        else:
                            shutil.copy2(src_path, dst_dir / f)
                            title = Path(f).stem
                            if rel_dir == Path("."):
                                nav_tree["files"][title] = f"modules/{f}"
                            else:
                                current["files"][title] = f"modules/{'/'.join(parts)}/{f}"
                    except (PermissionError, OSError) as pe:
                        logger.debug(f"Could not copy module doc file {f} (read-only destination): {pe}")

            # 3. Generate YAML lines recursively
            def node_to_yaml_lines(name: str, node: dict[str, Any], indent_level: int) -> list[str]:
                indent = " " * indent_level
                children = node["children"]
                files = node["files"]

                if not children and not files:
                    return []

                lines = [f"{indent}- {name}:"]
                for f_title in sorted(files.keys()):
                    f_path = files[f_title]
                    lines.append(f"{indent}    - {f_title}: {f_path}")

                for child_name in sorted(children.keys()):
                    child_node = children[child_name]
                    lines.extend(node_to_yaml_lines(child_name, child_node, indent_level + 4))
                return lines

            if not nav_tree["files"] and not nav_tree["children"]:
                logger.info("No module documentation files found to index; keeping existing mkdocs.yml navigation.")
                return

            nav_lines = ["  - Modules Documentation:"]
            for f_title in sorted(nav_tree["files"].keys()):
                nav_lines.append(f"      - {f_title}: {nav_tree['files'][f_title]}")
            for child_name in sorted(nav_tree["children"].keys()):
                child_node = nav_tree["children"][child_name]
                nav_lines.extend(node_to_yaml_lines(child_name, child_node, indent_level=6))

            # 4. Read mkdocs.yml and update content between markers
            with open(mkdocs_yml_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                content = f.read()

            pattern = r"(# \[DYNAMIC_MODULES_START\]\n).*?(\n\s*# \[DYNAMIC_MODULES_END\])"
            if not re.search(pattern, content, flags=re.DOTALL):
                logger.error("Could not find dynamic modules markers in mkdocs.yml")
                return

            nav_content = "\n".join(nav_lines)
            new_content = re.sub(pattern, r"\1" + nav_content + r"\2", content, flags=re.DOTALL)

            try:
                with open(mkdocs_yml_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.write(new_content)
                logger.success("Modules documentation dynamically re-indexed.")
            except (PermissionError, OSError) as pe:
                logger.warning(f"mkdocs.yml is read-only ({pe}). Dynamic re-indexing skipped.")
        except (PermissionError, OSError) as pe:
            logger.warning(
                f"Documentation directory is read-only (e.g. Program Files installation). Skipping dynamic re-indexing: {pe}"
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error dynamically indexing modules documentation: {e}")

def find_free_port(self, start_port: int = 8000) -> int:
    """Find an available port starting from start_port."""
    for port in range(start_port, start_port + 50):
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
            try:
                s.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
                return port
            except OSError:
                continue
    return start_port

def start_server(self) -> None:
    """Start the mkdocs local server and open the browser."""
    if self.is_running():
        return

    mkdocs_file = PROJECT_ROOT / "mkdocs.yml"
    if not mkdocs_file.exists():
        logger.error("mkdocs.yml not found in project root.")
        self._show_error_dialog(
            "Configuration Error",
            f"mkdocs.yml was not found in the project root:\n{PROJECT_ROOT}",
        )
        return

    # Dynamically re-index modules documentation before starting the server
    self._reindex_modules_docs()

    self.port = self.find_free_port(8000)
    try:
        startupinfo = None
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0  # SW_HIDE

        # Run Python module mkdocs serve on the found local port
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "mkdocs", "serve", "-a", f"127.0.0.1:{self.port}"]
        logger.info(f"Starting mkdocs server on port {self.port}: {' '.join(cmd)}")

        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT),
            startupinfo=startupinfo,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
        )

        # Wait briefly to see if it immediately fails/exits
        time.sleep(1.5)
        if self.process.poll() is not None:
            _, stderr = self.process.communicate()
            logger.error(f"MkDocs failed to start: {stderr}")
            self.process = None
            self._show_error_dialog(
                "MkDocs Launch Failed",
                "Failed to start MkDocs. Please ensure 'mkdocs' and its extensions are installed:\n\n"
                "pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mkdocstrings-python\n\n"
                f"Details:\n{stderr}",
            )
            return

        log_mkdocs = config.get("Debug", {}).get("log_mkdocs", False)

        def consume_stream(stream: Any) -> None:
            try:
                for line in stream:
                    cleaned = line.strip()
                    if not cleaned or not log_mkdocs:
                        continue
                    if "ERROR" in cleaned or "CRITICAL" in cleaned:
                        logger.bind(mkdocs=True).error(f"[MkDocs] {cleaned}")
                    elif "WARNING" in cleaned:
                        logger.bind(mkdocs=True).warning(f"[MkDocs] {cleaned}")
                    else:
                        logger.bind(mkdocs=True).info(f"[MkDocs] {cleaned}")
            except Exception:
                pass

        if self.process.stdout:
            threading.Thread(target=consume_stream, args=(self.process.stdout,), daemon=True).start()
        if self.process.stderr:
            threading.Thread(target=consume_stream, args=(self.process.stderr,), daemon=True).start()

        logger.info(f"Opening browser at http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}")
        webbrowser.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}")
        self.update_menu_visibility()

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to spawn mkdocs subprocess: {e}")
        self.process = None
        self._show_error_dialog("Subprocess Error", f"Could not launch the MkDocs process:\n{e}")

def stop_server(self) -> None:
    """Stop the mkdocs subprocess."""
    if self.process:
        logger.info("Stopping mkdocs server...")
        try:
            self.process.terminate()
            self.process.wait(timeout=2)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Error terminating mkdocs process gracefully: {e}")
            try:
                self.process.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.process = None
    self.update_menu_visibility()

def update_menu_visibility(self) -> None:
    """Update display status of Documentation menu items dynamically based on server status."""
    running = self.is_running()
    if dpg.does_item_exist("doc_open_item"):
        dpg.configure_item("doc_open_item", show=running)
    if dpg.does_item_exist("doc_start_item"):
        dpg.configure_item("doc_start_item", show=not running)
    if dpg.does_item_exist("doc_stop_item"):
        dpg.configure_item("doc_stop_item", show=running)
